description: Get full details for one camper listing by slug (listing page id) or camper id (cam_...). With a slug, searches sale listings first, then rentals; set segment to force "sale" or "rental". With camper_id, returns the camper spec sheet from the full catalog. Includes decoded specs, photo URLs, equipment, contact details and the listing URL. Set includePhotos to also attach actual camper photos as images so you can look at them.

camperId.description: Camper public id, e.g. cam_4aJ62weNfqbS (from search results).

includePhotos.description: Attach camper photos as images (400px thumbnails) the model can actually see.

maxDescriptionChars.description: Description is truncated to this many characters.

photoLimit.description: How many photos to attach when includePhotos is true.

segment.description: Which listing space the slug belongs to.

slug.description: Listing slug from search results, e.g. citroen-jumper-ba12fa.

name: get_camper_details
title: Get camper details
